guidance.statement: Targeting double-digit volume growth momentum in FY27
Marketing spend to rise to close to 5% of sales in FY27 from a little over 4% in FY26
Expects ₹40-50 Cr of Odisha subsidies to be realised in FY27
Annual EBITDA margin outlook retained at 19% to 21%.
Aim for double-digit volume growth for the financial year, phased across quarters.
Marketing spend to be kept at 4-5% of revenue.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Textiles > Textiles & Apparels > Garments & Apparels

operating_notes.text: Distribution network at about 116,600 multi-brand outlets, 1,615 exclusive brand stores and 893 large-format stores; one large-format store exited on commercial negotiations.
E-commerce contributes 15% of revenue, up a couple of percentage points year-on-year.
A 2% weighted average price increase was taken in January for product upgrades, with only 2-3 weeks of benefit realised in Q4 due to FIFO.
Sales volume was 61.9 million pieces in Q1FY27, up 5.7% YoY, with about three days of invoiced billing undelivered at quarter-end.
A 2.2% weighted average price increase was taken in May 2026, after 2.5% in January 2026; the May increase was linked to raw material cost.
Distribution stood at 115,871 multi-brand outlets, 1,640 exclusive brand stores and 930 large format stores; online is over 35% of the Speedo business.

timeline.summary: Page Industries' Q4FY26 call (21 May 2026) reported revenue up 14.1% to ₹1,253 Cr and volume up 10.8%, with FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 19-21% versus FY26's 22%.
Page Industries' Q1FY27 call (13 Aug 2026) reported revenue up 7.9% to ₹1,420 Cr and PAT down 4% to ₹193 Cr, with EBITDA margin at 20.3% and FY27 margin guidance held at 19-21%.
